title: Input coordinate of the CNF assignment
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, let $x$ be an input assignment, and let $i$ be an input position. The extended sign assignment associated with $x$, evaluated at the coordinate for input $i$, is the sign corresponding to the input bit $x(i)$.
